description: Keyword search over every GlobalHostia hosting, server, SSL and email plan, with filters for category, location and maximum monthly price. Returns matching plans with key specs, location, cheapest live price, product page and cart link. Prefer recommend_plan when the user describes a need rather than keywords.

category.description: Category slug or name from list_categories.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. USD or AED. Defaults to USD. An unsupported code returns an error listing the valid ones.

location.description: Datacenter location, e.g. USA, Germany, Singapore.

max_price.description: Maximum monthly-equivalent price in the chosen currency.

query.description: Free text, e.g. "windows vps 8gb ram", "wordpress", "dedicated server usa". Leave empty to browse a category.

name: search_products
title: Search hosting products
